subject: Acme Health: private offer term exception and buyer approval path
messages:
From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@acmehealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Suresh Patel <suresh.p@acmehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: AWS private offer — 18 month term, pricing and buyer approval path

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the product demo last week — the team at Acme Health liked the latency benchmarks. Procurement asked me to follow up with a few specifics so we can start the AWS Private Offer process:

- Our procurement prefers an 18-month contract term (budget cycle alignment).
- We typically need a pricing matrix with list/discount by commitment tiers and any prepay options.
- We also need a clear buyer approval path: which internal approvals or signatures AWS expects (PO vs contract signature), and if there are any AWS Marketplace prerequisites that could delay the private offer (e.g., seller account attestation).

Can you share a sample offer sheet and confirm whether Redwood supports 18-month private offers via AWS Marketplace (we saw standard guidance for 12 months)? If 18 months is an exception, what approvals do you need internally and how long does that take?

Attaching our procurement requirements for reference. Looking to get this on the purchase calendar for June.

Regards,
Marta Ruiz
Sr. Procurement Manager — Acme Health
marta.ruiz@acmehealth.com
Acme Health

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 10:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS private offer — 18 month term, pricing and buyer approval path

Hi Marta — great to hear from you and thanks for the doc.

Short answers up front: we can pursue an 18-month private offer, but that is an exception to our standard AWS Marketplace cadence (we usually do 12- or 36-month terms). Exceptions require approval from Pricing & Contracts and Marketplace Ops — timing is typically 3–7 business days once we have the buyer PO + proposed payment terms.

I'm attaching an initial pricing workbook (redwood_initial_pricing.xlsx) with suggested tiers and our standard prepay discounts. If Acme plans to prepay 100% we can surface an additional one-time discount; I'll flag that for approval.

Next steps I suggest:
- Confirm target ARR / commitment tier you expect for the 18 months.
- Share whether Acme will submit an AWS PO (Marketplace Private Offer flow) or sign an external contract + PO.
- I'll start the internal approval path and loop in Marketplace Ops so they can validate any AWS-side requirements.

Can you confirm timeline for the June purchase calendar?

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai

Vanessa / Jordan / Laura — forwarding Acme's ask.

Summary: Acme Health (Marta Ruiz) wants an 18-month AWS Marketplace private offer. They may prepay. Procurement needs a clear buyer-approval path for AWS (PO vs signature). They want to close in June.

Proposal for redwood: approve 18-month term as a one-time exception under the following guardrails:
- Max effective discount 15% list for 18 months unless they prepay 100% (in which case consider up to 20% one-time discount).
- Require buyer to submit AWS Private Offer PO and confirm billing entity.
- Require Marketplace Ops to validate seller account eligibility and to submit the private offer with AWS Partner team.

Attachments forwarded: acme_procurement_requirements.pdf, redwood_initial_pricing.xlsx

Please advise: do we need a pricing exception + legal signoff? Jordan, can you open the Marketplace Ops ticket if we agree to proceed? Laura / Vanessa, any constraints on discount/term approvals here?

Thanks for the context, Karthik. I'm comfortable approving a one-off 18-month private offer as long as Marketplace Ops validates seller eligibility with AWS and we capture the following:

- Signed buyer PO submitted through AWS Private Offer flow (we cannot process outside PO without legal signoff).
- Confirmation on billing entity and tax documentation.
- If prepay = 100% then we can approve up to 20% one-time discount; otherwise cap at 15% for 18 months.
- Limit the exception to this deal and require a post-implementation review in Q4 to assess unit economics.

Jordan: please open a Marketplace Ops ticket and start the AWS Private Offer intake. Add the AWS Partner team point-of-contact and include acme_procurement_requirements.pdf and the initial pricing workbook. Also create a HubSpot task linking to deal RED-ACME-2026-042 (link below) and set the expected close date to 2026-06-11.

Karthik: please confirm whether Acme will prepay or invoice monthly so we can finalize the discount. Once we have the buyer PO and prepay decision, I'll route the pricing exception for final signoff (pricing + legal).

Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Sales Operations — Redwood Inference
